entries.title: Fixed Twin Windowed Hollow Core and Step Aerator
entries.description: One newly authored complete static twin hollow-core lawn-tool exterior. Two whole thick round cores have true top and bottom openings and long front side windows. One rear-offset full foot crossbar joins the shells while leaving both central bores uncapped; a tall continuous U frame and complete upper grip form the whole handle. Not a square soil former duplicated or a roller shoe with extra tubes: there is no ejector, plunger, forming box, roller or cutting shoe. All visible coordinates new. One model zero scenes. Blunt illustrative empty tool only; no soil coring, aeration, clearing, pressing, force, ergonomics, manufacture, compatibility or safety claim. Rig, animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Single Roll and Curved Shoe Pedestal Ironer
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed floor-standing roller-ironer-style exterior. A single full broad horizontal padded-looking cylinder sits on a complete transverse axle between short side seats supported by a rear-offset pedestal and crosshead. A separate continuous thick concave shoe shell follows the rear arc of the cylinder with a real fixed radial gap, leaving the front cylinder exposed. A wide low feed board on two whole under-brackets projects in front; a single broad foot pedal and its fixed short support root into the common lower frame. Two entire long ground feet, lower cross-tie and one blank side control finish the whole appliance. Unlike the old hand wringer there is no second stacked roller, tall pressure frame, upper adjustment screws, side hand crank, catch pan or draped cloth. Unlike the upright garment press there are no two long facing boards, bottom-opening panel or clothes hanger. Every visible mesh newly authored, not old rollers or old panels moved to a different stand. Three opaque solid PBR roles, metres Z up and full horizontally centred ground datum. One model zero scenes. Empty static artistic exterior only: no cloth, electricity, heating, pressure, roll or shoe motion, fabric feeding, ironing result, foot control, human suitability, manufacture, installation or safety performance. Rigging animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Ring Tube and Open Canopy Raft
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed canopied ring-tube raft exterior for dry static display. Two full continuous flattened-bottom oval perimeter tubes surround one recessed solid floor; a thick continuous arched canopy has closed sides and back and a genuinely open front aperture. The canopy lower sides and rear are rooted in the perimeter and floor, not suspended above them. A whole short ribbed front boarding tongue joins the lower ring, and a continuous external grab rope is held by six separate rooted loop keepers. Unlike the old twin-float pedalboat there are no separate pointed hulls, seats, transverse paddle drive or rudder; unlike the cross-pole tent this has a complete annular double-tube perimeter and low floor bay, no diagonal external poles or independent camping base. The whole numeric assembly is newly authored rather than old hulls and a tent imported into a scene. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres Z up, horizontal bounds centred and finite flattened lower tube sole. One prop zero scenes. Fixed empty illustrative appearance only: no inflation, gas chamber, buoyancy, floating, deployment, boarding, capacity, occupancy, weather protection, rescue function, rope tension, manufacture, installation or maritime safety performance. No water, people, emergency markings, rigging, animation or interaction.
